review_text: Needed a safety net for the balcony to keep my peace of mind. Specifically wanted it for sports; the kids are *rough*! Installation in Mailardevpally was quick and efficient, and there was absolutely no mess left behind. Good, sturdy work. They offered color options, which was a nice surprise. Four stars because communication could be a *little* better. Overall, a great solution for pet safety and stray balls!
